category.name: Split Document
category.preferred_workflow: Create a deterministic source document, choose a native split approach (section import, HtmlSaveOptions.DocumentSplitCriteria, or Document.ExtractPages), use NodeImporter when moving nodes between documents, optionally define a DocumentPartSavingCallback for custom naming or format selection, save each part, and verify that the expected files exist.

strict_api_bans: Do not reference members, types, or namespaces that are not present in Aspose.Words 26.11.0.
canonical_patterns: Use documented split mechanisms such as HtmlSaveOptions.DocumentSplitCriteria, Document.ExtractPages, or manual section import with NodeImporter.
nullable_warning_prevention: Validate that all objects (Document, DocumentBuilder, NodeImporter, callbacks) are instantiated before use and that page indices are within the document's page count.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: The code references types or members such as DocumentSplitCriteria.Heading, Importing namespace, or SplitDocumentOptions that do not exist in the selected package version.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Invented or outdated API names were used instead of the documented members available in Aspose.Words 26.11.0.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace the nonexistent members with the correct documented equivalents, e.g., use HtmlSaveOptions.DocumentSplitCriteria = DocumentSplitCriteria.HeadingParagraph and remove any Importing namespace references.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the official Aspose.Words API reference for the exact member names before writing split logic.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException indicating that a page index or end index is out of range.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Page-based splitting used zero-based indices without adjusting for the document's actual page count, or supplied ranges exceeded the document's total pages.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Validate the document's PageCount and ensure start indices are zero-based while end indices do not exceed PageCount; adjust custom ranges accordingly.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always compute and check page boundaries before calling Document.ExtractPages.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime throws ArgumentException or InvalidOperationException when inserting a node created from a different Document instance.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Nodes were appended directly to a target document without using NodeImporter, violating Aspose.Words' ownership rules.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Import each node with NodeImporter (ImportFormatMode.KeepSourceFormatting) before appending it to the destination document.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Never mix nodes from different Document objects without explicit import.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: NullReferenceException occurs during split processing, typically when accessing a DocumentBuilder, Section, or callback that was never instantiated.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The workflow omitted required object creation steps or relied on external files that were not generated locally.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Instantiate all required objects explicitly and create any sample source files before loading or processing them.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Follow the rule to create local bootstrap inputs for every task that references a file, folder, or stream.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails because IDocumentPartSavingCallback or related members are missing or mismatched, or runtime errors occur when the callback is invoked.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The example attempted to assign a lambda or set a property that does not exist on SaveOptions, or the callback class did not implement the required interface members.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Define a class that implements IDocumentPartSavingCallback with the DocumentPartSaving method, and pass an instance to the appropriate SaveOptions property (e.g., HtmlSaveOptions.DocumentPartSavingCallback).
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Use the documented callback pattern and verify the interface signature against the Aspose.Words version in use.

narrative.overview: The Split Document category illustrates how to divide Word, HTML, EPUB, and other source files into separate parts using Aspose.Words 26.11.0. Verified examples demonstrate loading a DOCX, configuring HtmlSaveOptions with DocumentSplitCriteria, extracting pages, and manually importing sections while preserving formatting and layout.
narrative.purpose: Equip an AI coding assistant with concise, reproducible patterns for splitting documents by sections, headings, pages, or custom ranges, and for saving each part with optional callbacks, ensuring full compatibility with the documented Aspose.Words API.
validation_priorities: Prioritize confirming that each expected output file exists and that its content matches the intended split scope.
maintenance_notes: Update the examples whenever a new Aspose.Words version adds, renames, or deprecates split-related members to keep the documentation current.
